scope: Corollary 7.5 of the manuscript “All-temperature pressure for orthogonally invariant Ising spin glasses” (preprints/All-temperature-pressure-for-orthogonally-invariant-Ising-spin-glasses-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 234 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ecaeb31108feca6f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 44. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let JN = UT N ΛN UN satisfy the deterministic spectral hypotheses of Theorem 1.1, with limiting law μ. Define its maximum energy per spin by MN = 1 2N max σ∈{−1,1}N σT JN σ. For β > 0, let μβ be the image of μ under λ |→ βλ. Then, almost surely and in expectation, MN −→ lim β→∞ F(μβ) β . (7.10) In particular, the limit on the right exists.
